purpose: Generate a local development pilot of the native ECDLP/PDP dataset to build and debug the training and evaluation pipeline of docs/ml-dataset/training-protocol-20261101.md. Per that contract, development data may tune parsers and debug a model; it may not select a winner, estimate generalization, or provide a final test set.

claims.text: the export-join-train-evaluate pipeline runs end to end with leakage checks and grouped splits
development metrics under leave-one-field-size-out are reported for pipeline debugging only

splits: exporter split components (field size) used as independent units; evaluation by leave-one-component-out; no row-random split

controls.negative: within-stratum label permutation (stratum = arm x family x m)
controls.positive: a feature-leak canary column equal to the label, run only to show the leakage scan and evaluator detect it, never in a reported model

decision_rule: none: development-only; no winner selected and no generalization estimate claimed
